analysis_placeholder: Select a video to analyze it automatically.
preview_placeholder: Choose a source video to see an instant preview of the current settings.
resource_no_psutil: psutil not installed: Pause/Resume, live CPU-core control, and CPU/GPU stats are unavailable. Install with: pip install psutil (then restart this app).
note_cores_priority: Cores and priority apply at Start, and live while running.
note_pro_mode: Full CRF range, extra tone-mapping curves, brightness trim.
note_resolution: Width is computed automatically to keep the source's aspect ratio.
container_note: MP4 — widest device/player support. MKV — needed if the source has subtitle or audio tracks (e.g. PGS, DTS) that MP4 can't hold when copied as-is.
note_setup: Installs FFmpeg and/or HandBrakeCLI via winget if missing. Progress streams into Activity. Windows may show a permission (UAC) prompt during install — that's normal.
tonemap_info_bt.2390: ITU-R reference curve: smooth highlight rolloff, preserves midtone contrast (recommended for GPU).
tonemap_info_hable: Filmic curve (Uncharted 2): smooth rolloff, punchy midtones (recommended for CPU).
tonemap_info_reinhard: Classic photographic operator: flatter, lower-contrast curve.
tonemap_info_mobius: Gentler highlight shoulder: retains more detail in bright areas.
tonemap_info_bt.2446a: ITU-R broadcast method: alternative if BT.2390 appears too contrasty.
tonemap_info_auto: Automatically adapts tone mapping curve per scene.
tonemap_info_st2094-40: Uses source HDR10+ dynamic metadata when present.
tonemap_info_st2094-10: Uses source ST2094-10 dynamic metadata when present.
tonemap_info_clip: Hard-clips luminance above SDR white (diagnostic use).
tonemap_info_none: Direct pass-through without tone mapping (colors will appear washed out).
dlg_busy_msg: Finish or stop the current conversion/setup first.
dlg_winget_missing_msg:
Windows Package Manager (winget) isn't available.

Install 'App Installer' from the Microsoft Store, then try again:
https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9nblggh4nns1
dlg_nothing_to_install_msg: FFmpeg and HandBrakeCLI are already installed.
log_setup_installing_n: [setup] Installing {n} package(s) via winget — a Windows permission prompt may appear; approve it to continue.
dlg_setup_complete_msg: Dependency installation finished — see Activity log for details.
log_setup_item_failed_code: [setup] {name} install exited with code {code} — see output above.
dlg_ffprobe_missing_msg: Bundle ffprobe with FFmpeg or install FFmpeg.
analysis_note_dolby: Dolby Vision detected. A compatible HDR10 base layer is required for dependable SDR output.
analysis_note_hdr: HDR detected. Tone mapping is appropriate.
analysis_note_sdr: Likely SDR/Rec.709. Tone mapping is normally unnecessary.
analysis_failed_unicode: Analysis failed reading ffprobe's output ({error}). This is usually a corrupted/unusual metadata tag in the file itself, not a problem with the video streams - conversion can often still proceed.
rec_sdr: Tone mapping isn't really needed here - if you convert anyway, a gentle CPU tonemap curve (or Pro mode → None) is safer than forcing BT.2390 on non-HDR footage.
rec_dolby: Results depend on this file having a usable HDR10 base layer - if the output looks off, that's the likely reason.
rec_hdr10plus: This source carries HDR10+ dynamic metadata - enable Pro mode and pick ST2094-40 for the most accurate result.
rec_bt2390_good: BT.2390 on GPU (the default) is a good fit for this source.
rec_no_bt2390: This FFmpeg build has no usable BT.2390/libplacebo - Hable (CPU tonemap) is the best curve available here.
dlg_already_running_msg: A conversion is already in progress.
dlg_setup_in_progress_msg: Wait for dependency installation to finish first.
dlg_handbrake_missing_msg: Install HandBrakeCLI and ensure it's on PATH, or switch the backend to FFmpeg.
dlg_already_sdr_msg: This source appears to be SDR; conversion was not started.
dlg_dolby_question: Continue only if it contains an HDR10-compatible base layer?
dlg_gpu_tonemap_unavailable_msg: This FFmpeg lacks libplacebo/Vulkan support. Use a CPU tonemap curve or install a libplacebo-enabled FFmpeg build.
dlg_curve_unavailable_msg: This libplacebo build doesn't support {code} (needs a newer FFmpeg/libplacebo). Try BT.2390 or BT.2446A instead.
dlg_encoder_unavailable_msg: {encoder} is not available in this FFmpeg build or GPU driver.
preview_unavailable_handbrake: Live preview isn't available with the HandBrakeCLI backend.
preview_waiting_first_frame: Waiting for the first preview frame…
dlg_hb_encoder_unavailable_msg: This HandBrakeCLI build doesn't support the '{encoder}' encoder/profile.
dlg_could_not_start_msg: Failed to start the encoder process.
dlg_psutil_required_msg:
{feature} requires the psutil package, which isn't installed.

    pip install psutil

dlg_save_preview_failed_msg: Couldn't save the image to that location.
preview_install_ffmpeg: Install FFmpeg to see an instant preview of the current settings here.

tooltip_preset_optimal: Apply the Optimal tone-mapping curve for this source (matches the app defaults in most cases).
tooltip_preset_best: Apply the Best quality settings: CPU · H.265, Pro mode, low CRF, best available curve. Slower.
tooltip_preset_fast: Apply the Fast settings: hardware encoder if this machine has one (else CPU · H.264), simple curve.
tooltip_view_full_size: View full size — open the current preview frame in a larger window.
tooltip_save_frame: Save frame — save the current preview frame to disk as an image.

tooltip_test_clip_cancel: Cancel the test clip render currently in progress.
status_test_clip_rendering: Rendering a 5s test clip with the current settings…
status_test_clip_failed: Test clip render failed — check the Activity log for details.
dlg_conversion_running_msg: Wait for the current conversion to finish first.
hwaccel_note_hb_nvenc: HandBrakeCLI: enables NVDEC decoding for this NVENC encoder.
hwaccel_note_hb_other: HandBrakeCLI: only has an effect with an NVIDIA NVENC encoder — no effect with the current encoder.
hwaccel_note_ffmpeg: FFmpeg: requests CUDA / DXVA2 / VideoToolbox decoding automatically.
brightness_note_hb_unavailable: Not available on the HandBrake backend (no equivalent filter) — switch to FFmpeg to use it.
saturation_note_hb_unavailable: Not available on the HandBrake backend (no equivalent filter) — switch to FFmpeg to use it.
analysis_tooltip_warn: Note: source primaries are {primaries}, not the usual BT.2020 - tone mapping assumes a BT.2020 gamut, so colours may be off.
analysis_warn_primaries: ⚠ primaries are {primaries}, not BT.2020 — colours may be off
preset_optimal_note_sdr: tone mapping off — already the default for non-HDR sources
preset_optimal_note_dolby: BT.2390 · GPU, same as HDR — needs a usable HDR10 base layer
preset_optimal_note_hdr10plus: ST2094-40 · Pro mode — matches this source's HDR10+ metadata
preset_optimal_note_bt2390: BT.2390 · GPU — already the app default
preset_optimal_note_fallback: Hable · CPU — BT.2390/libplacebo unavailable in this FFmpeg build
preset_best_note: CPU · H.265, Pro mode, low CRF — slower, highest fidelity
preset_fast_note_gpu: {gpu} — hardware, much faster, still solid quality
preset_fast_note_cpu: CPU · H.264 or a higher CRF — no hardware encoder detected ({cores} cores)
perf_rec_gpu: For speed with still-solid quality, this machine has {gpu} available — much faster than CPU encoding. For the best achievable quality (at the cost of encode time), use CPU · H.265 with Pro mode and a low CRF instead.
perf_rec_cpu: No hardware encoder was detected here, so encoding runs on the CPU ({cores} cores available) — CPU · H.265 gives the best quality; CPU · H.264, a higher CRF, or limiting cores less aggressively trades some quality for shorter encode times.
tonemap_info_spline: libplacebo default: adapts pivot to scene brightness for consistent contrast.
tooltip_queue_list: Videos waiting to be converted with the current settings.
tooltip_output_folder: Output folder for converted files (default: next to source). Right-click for history.
tooltip_analyze: Analyze the selected queue item before converting it.
tooltip_open_folder: Open the folder the converted file is (or will be) saved to.
tooltip_history: View past conversions (source, when, and whether they succeeded).
tooltip_test_clip_render: Render a short test clip to preview quality and motion before converting.
tooltip_container:
MKV: recommended default (supports all audio and subtitle tracks).
MP4: maximum device compatibility (may reject some audio/subtitle formats).
tooltip_install: Installs FFmpeg/HandBrakeCLI if either is missing. If both are already installed, offers to update FFmpeg instead.
tooltip_check_updates: Check for app and tool (FFmpeg / HandBrakeCLI) updates.
hint_drop_videos: Drop video files here, or add them to the conversion queue.
tooltip_dv_rpu: Applies Dolby Vision dynamic metadata (RPU) before tone mapping. Disable if output displays incorrect colors or tinting.
tooltip_peak_detect: Dynamically measures peak brightness per scene on GPU. Improves contrast in scenes with large brightness swings.
msg_quit_still_converting: A conversion is still running - quitting now stops it with an incomplete output file. Quit anyway?
msg_close_still_converting:
A conversion is still running. Closing now stops it right where it is - the output file will be incomplete, and (unlike Stop mid-session) there's no resuming it once the app has fully quit.

Minimize to the system tray instead to let it keep converting in the background.
chk_skip_mini_full: Always open Pro mode (skip mini window)
msg_read_error_short: Couldn't read this file - open Pro mode for more detail.
msg_delete_preset_confirm: Delete the preset “{name}”? This can't be undone.
status_dolby_detected: Dolby Vision detected — needs an HDR10-compatible base layer.
status_done_saved: Done — saved next to the source.
msg_deps_already_installed: FFmpeg and HandBrakeCLI are already installed. Update either to the latest portable build?
status_live_preview_resume_unavailable: Live preview isn't available while resuming a failed conversion.
msg_no_tray: No system tray available on this system.
tooltip_open_pro: Open the full interface (all settings, queue, live preview).
msg_clear_history_confirm: Remove all recorded conversion history? This can't be undone.
tooltip_save_preset: Save current colours as a new preset
tooltip_skip_mini: Skip this launcher next time and start straight in the full interface.
msg_tray_still_converting: Still converting in the background — click the tray icon to reopen.
status_stopped_drop_again: Stopped. Drop the file again to retry, or open Pro mode.
tooltip_neon_base: Switch the neon theme's background between black and white — your accent colour stays the same.
msg_output_folder_gone: That entry's output folder isn't available anymore.
msg_resume_body:
The conversion got to about {done} of {total} before failing.

Resume picks up from close to that point instead of re-encoding the whole file again from the start. The parts get joined into the same output file once the rest finishes.
status_already_sdr: This already looks like SDR — conversion isn't needed.
tooltip_quality_mode:
CRF/CQ: constant quality (variable file size, default).
Bitrate: target average bitrate (fixed bandwidth budget).
msg_convert_selected_or_queue: Convert only the file selected in the queue, or the whole queue in order?
tooltip_autocrop: Detects and crops black letterbox bars before encoding.
tooltip_denoise: Reduces noise and grain before tone mapping.
tooltip_resharpen: Applies a light sharpening pass after downscaling to preserve edge detail.
tooltip_deband: Smooths color banding artifacts in gradients (skies, shadows).
tooltip_trim_handles: Trim — drag the handles to choose the test clip's start and end. The still-preview frame follows whichever handle you're dragging.
tooltip_quality_slider_inverted: Lower CRF/CQ = higher quality (less compression, larger file). Drag right for higher quality.
tooltip_preset_best_pro: Apply the Best quality settings: CPU · H.265, low CRF, best available curve. Slower.
tooltip_preset_best_mini: CPU · H.265, low CRF, best available curve. Slower.
tooltip_preset_optimal_mini: Matches this source's recommended settings - a safe default.
tooltip_preset_fast_mini: Hardware encoder if available, simple curve. Quickest.

tooltip_theme_reset: Reset this theme to its original default look.

tooltip_gamut_mapping:
Gamut mapping (GPU only) — maps wide-gamut colors (BT.2020 / DCI-P3) to SDR (BT.709):
• Perceptual: smooth perceptual compression (recommended).
• Relative: colorimetric mapping preserving in-gamut hues.
• Clip: hard clipping of out-of-gamut highlights.

tooltip_desat_highlights: Desaturates extreme highlights toward white to avoid tinting in blown-out areas.
